def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The uniform center column separates equally sized panels.
    sep = min((c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1),
              key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
    n = min(sep, w - sep - 1)
    left = [row[sep-n:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:sep+1+n] for row in grid]
    common = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    # The panels share exactly one color; use it for unequal cells.
    base = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else base
             for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
